name: Mailgun Send Free
free_limit: 100 transactional emails per day on the hosted Free plan; REST email API and SMTP relay, 1 custom sending domain, 1 inbound route and 1-day log retention.
watch_out: 100-email daily cap; domain verification and deliverability setup required. Free plan does not include paid email validation or higher-volume sending; upgrades and overages on paid plans may incur charges. Official pricing and help pages differ on API key count (1 versus 2).
